risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (329.6) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD headwind for energy multinationals, and earnings binary event in 6 days create compounded macro and event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + supertrend bullish + Ichimoku above cloud form intermediate trend structure with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 329.6), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 79.33, Stoch 88.28) combined with critical earnings event in 6 days, inverted yield curve, strong USD headwind, zero fundamental conviction, and price below both 50/200 SMA create compounded event and macro risk that outweighs technical setup.
